title: The Neo-Babylonian Empire
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 626–539 B.C. (AP-45). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 605 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-45: Dynasty 8: Neo-Babylonian Empire: 626–539 B.C."
chronologies.note: Berossus Dynasty 8: 87 years from Nabopolassar (626/625 B.C.) to the conquest of Babylon by Darius the Mede and Cyrus (539 B.C.).

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 11 "Babylon Has Fallen (626–539 BC)", PDF p. 332 (printed p. 331)
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "605–539 BC" (PDF p. 483): the same date.
